name: wo-60
cmd: nproc; GDP_ENUM_LOG=1 GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 300 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only consensus_wo_decide --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log; s=$?; grep -E '^\[enum\]|join (enumerated|end)|\[infer\] (start|runs|kernel|end)' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-260 | tail -c 50000; times; exit $s
